rawText:
Found 15 items in registries @quiz-ui:

Showing items 1-15 of 15:

- quiz-cn (registry:lib) - className composition helper (clsx + tailwind-merge) used by every quiz-ui component. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-core (registry:hook) - Headless quiz engine: state machine, branching resolution, and the useQuizEngine/useQuizStep/useQuizAnswers hooks. Installed automatically as a dependency of every component below. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-root (registry:component) - Top-level funnel wrapper; owns the engine via QuizProvider. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-step (registry:component) - Renders the active step's question heading and answer input. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-progress (registry:component) - Progress bar with a 'Step N of M' label, on Radix Progress. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-choice (registry:component) - Single- and multi-select answer cards, on Radix RadioGroup/Checkbox. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-image-choice (registry:component) - Visual/image-based single-select answer grid. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-slider (registry:component) - Single-thumb range input for numeric answers. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-rating (registry:component) - Star or numeric rating scale, on Radix ToggleGroup. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-text-input (registry:component) - Free-text answer input. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-email-input (registry:component) - Email capture input with basic format validation. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-navigation (registry:component) - Back/Next controls; Next disables automatically until the step is answered. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-transition (registry:component) - Fade/slide transition wrapper for step changes. Requires a Tailwind keyframe — see the component's JSDoc. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-result (registry:component) - Renders its children only once the funnel is complete. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- quiz-dialog (registry:component) - Modal-embedded funnel wrapper, on Radix Dialog. [@quiz-ui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
